history.p: Although Gade as early as 1860 had told Carl Reinecke that he had finished a piano trio, he did not start sketching it until February 1862, finishing it almost two years later.

physDesc.physMedium: Bound in brown paperboard with cloth spine. Written in ink. Paper: 20 staves (title page) and 16 staves (music). Paginated 1-28. Title page and verso unnumbered. Heading on p. 1: "Trio" and signed "Niels W: Gade Op. 42.". With numerous cancellations and emendations.

physDesc.physMedium: 1 single folio. Paper: 16 staves. With the dedication: "Hr. Krause / In freundlicher Erinnerung / Niels W. Gade / 1864".

Bound in cardboard cover with marbled sides and cloth spine. In upper left-hand corner of the cover a handwritten label inscribed "Piano - Trio, i F / op. 52." probably in Emil Erslev's hand. In the middle of the cover in Gade's hand: "Trio for Piano, V. og Cello / af / Niels W. Gade / Op. 42." Written in ink. Paper: 16 staves. Paginated 1-25 in Gade's hand. At the end of the music on p. 25 signed and dated: "Fine / Niels W. Gade / [Gade's musical signature] / December 1863. / Kjøbenhavn.". Page 26 blank.
